matched: Fear created attractive long-term prices for sound American businesses. → When others are fearful, the market often provides us with the opportunity to purchase such businesses at prices that offer a substantial margin of safety.
A bad near-term economy does not identify the market's turning point. → We do not attempt to forecast the bottom of the market or the near-term path of the economy, as such efforts are futile.
